sentences: RDNA2 ISA: `v_dot2_i32_i16`/`u16` (2×16-bit), `v_dot4_u32_u8` (4×8-bit unsigned), and `v_dot8_i32_i4`/`u4` (8×4-bit) extract each element with `OpBitFieldSExtract`/`OpBitFieldUExtract`, sum the elementwise products with `S2` wrapping at 32 bits, and saturate to `[INT32_MIN, INT32_MAX]` / `[0, UINT32_MAX]` under VOP3P `clamp` (signed carry tracking handles the `v_dot2_i32_i16` `(-32768)^2 + (-32768)^2 + S2` overflow/cancellation edge).

The hardware default `op_sel:[0,0,0]` and `op_sel_hi:[1,1,1]` (whether omitted or written explicitly) is accepted; any other `op_sel`/`op_sel_hi` (such as `op_sel_hi:[0,0,0]` or `[0,1,1]`, which select the low half for lane 1 on `v_dot2_*`), `neg_lo`/`neg_hi`, DPP/SDWA forms, and source `neg`/`abs` raise `Unsupported`. (`v_dot4_i32_i8` and `v_dot4c_i32_i8` are covered separately in the Signed-byte dot products row, #1754.) `v_pk_fmac_f16` (VOP2) unpacks `src0`, `vsrc1` and `vdst` as `f16x2` (`Gen.src_h`, so inline float constants apply in the low half with `+0.0` high), computes `fma(src0[k], vsrc1[k], vdst[k])` per half with single f16 rounding (`Gen.fma_f16_odd`, SHADER-55), and packs with `Gen.f16_pack2`; any modifier outside `_dpp` or non-VGPR `vdst` raises `Unsupported`, and `v_pk_fmac_f16` marks `vdst` as read before write in `read_before_write_vgprs` and `reg_reads_writes`.

**Hardware-confirmed on RDNA2:** on `gfx1036` (Ryzen 9 7950X3D iGPU, `tools/hw_oracle`, @aslan2142), all 60 integer dot-product sets (plain, swapped/SGPR sources, and `clamp`) match bit-for-bit, all measured `op_sel`/`neg_*` variants are refused, and all 22 `v_pk_fmac_f16` default-MODE (`0x000003C0`: round-to-nearest-even, f16 denormals kept, IEEE and DX10_CLAMP on) words match in both source orders (all 34 non-NaN halves bit-exact; the 10 NaN halves yield quiet f16 NaN, as SPIR-V does not preserve NaN payload bits or sign); independently confirmed on `gfx1035` (Radeon 680M, `tools/hw_oracle`, @Youssefrah16) across 18 cases × wave32/wave64 (36/36 bit-exact).

Pinned by `tests/semantic/test_alu_dot_pk_fmac.py` (all 82 `gfx1036` measured tables plus hand-written `.asm` fixture, boundary/clamp cases, default/non-default `op_sel`/`op_sel_hi`, `read_before_write_vgprs`/`reg_reads_writes`, DPP, seeded sweeps, and rejected forms).
Non-default f16 MODEs (denormal flush, RTZ) are not modelled on `v_pk_fmac_f16` while the translator has no MODE input.
